statement.p: Find the equation of the tangent plane to z = e^{y}+x+x^{5}+4 at the point (5, 0, 3135).

static.solution: z = e^{y}+x+x^{5}+4. The partial derivatives are {\partial z\over\partial x}\bigg|_{(x,y) = (5,0)} = 1+5x^{4}\bigg|_{(x,y)=(5,0)} = 3126, and {\partial z\over\partial y}\bigg|_{(x,y) = (5,0)} = e^{y}\bigg|_{(x,y)=(5,0)} = 1. So the equation of the tangent plane is z = 3135 + 3126(x - 5) + 1(y - 0) = 3135+3126\mathopen{}\left(x-5\right)+y.
